lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Mo₃B₄ (Mo₁₂B₁₆ per cell) crystallizes in the trigonal space group P-3m1 (No. 164), with 28 atoms distributed over 9 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies boron-centered octahedral environments with six neighbors (one B, five Mo) and molybdenum environments with 7 or 10 geometric neighbors, among which Mo–Mo distances range from about 2.33 to 3.18 Å. The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows B–B octahedra linked by corner, edge, and face contacts, and Mo 10-vertex polyhedra sharing corners and faces.
